description: Attempt to reinterpret project-curated overlap as historical relation.

denominator_definition: All unordered pairs in the authoritative public cohort.

known_failure_modes: Jaccard is a benchmark diagnostic, not the selected similarity metric.

description: Analysis-only project-curated membership substrate.

description: Number of curated containers assigned to a public object.

description: Exact number of curated containers shared by a public-object pair.
